    for _ in range(m):
        x = data[idx] - 1
        y = data[idx + 1] - 1
        idx += 2
        adj[x] |= 1 << y
        adj[y] |= 1 << x

    valid = bytearray(total)
    valid[0] = 1

    ans = 0

        if valid[rest] and (adj[v] & rest) == 0:
            valid[mask] = 1
            ans += 1
